summary: Iteration 10 security-hardening validation complete. Backend: 12/12 tests passed (admin + user regression, short-password rejection, subscription upgrade restriction, 401 on protected endpoints, admin RBAC 403 for non-admins, security headers present, IDOR scoped by user_id for transactions & invoices, brute-force 429 lockout, robots.txt & sitemap.xml served). Frontend: Landing footer Privacy/Terms links, /privacy, /terms, custom 404 page, Go-to-Homepage link, admin login -> dashboard, and transactions page all render correctly with dark theme.

minor.issue: Silently returns 200 for cross-user update (because query is scoped by user_id so no document matches). Not an IDOR vuln (no data leak/modification occurs) but response is misleading. Consider returning 404 when matched_count == 0 for clarity.

action_items: (Optional) Return 404 from PUT /api/transactions/{id} when no document matched to make IDOR behavior explicit.
critical_code_review_comments: Register rate limit (5/hour/IP) is strict and caused test setup fixtures to skip when the same IP ran several registrations. For legitimate shared-NAT users this could block real signups; consider raising or combining with CAPTCHA.
PUT /api/transactions/{tx_id} returns 200 regardless of ownership (good for IDOR safety, bad for API semantics).
seed_data_creation: Multiple TEST_ random-email users registered during run. Rate-limit docs in db.rate_limits cleared between runs via mongosh.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Register endpoint field is 'name' (not 'full_name'). Invoice create requires 'customer_name' (not client_name). No GET /api/transactions/{id} endpoint exists — IDOR tested via PUT/DELETE which are scoped by user_id in the Mongo query. To avoid rate-limit interference, clear db.rate_limits and db.login_attempts between runs: mongosh --quiet --eval 'db.getSiblingDB("test_database").rate_limits.deleteMany({}); db.getSiblingDB("test_database").login_attempts.deleteMany({})'. All hardening features verified working.
